snippet.title: Arcade Up 'N Down - 596,370 pts
snippet.description:
🕹️ ABOUT UP 'N DOWN ARCADE

Up 'N Down is a classic vertically scrolling driving game developed and released by Sega in 1983. Players control a purple baja buggy, jumping over hazards, collecting flags, and avoiding crashes to rack up points.
